authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13952 haḍḍa lists Oriya hāṛa, Hindi haḍḍī, Gujarati hāḍ and Marathi hāḍ bone; the addendum explicitly includes hāṛkɔ and hāḍkī. These bone forms fit that family, including k-extended forms. The remote connection to asthi is explicitly very doubtful. Exact survey form haḍki is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
